title: Fuzzy double-image on sprites
backstory: All the sprites have a faint ghost image slightly to their right. At first glance it looks like the game is at the wrong resolution, but it's actually ringing on the video signal.
visible_effect: Lua overlay adds a pale rightward ghost tint; CRT preview shows ringing_ghosting shader
diagnosis_hint: Video ringing is almost always a bad peaking coil or video amplifier overshoot. On the Centipede PCB, look at the video output path between the RGB resistor network and J1. A bad termination resistor (75 Ω) at the video connector causes reflections that show up as ghosting.
